title: Xanthe and the Visitor
author: Elodie Vasquez
blurb: Dominic Winterbourne, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
